tools.name: get_platform_image_size
tools.description: Recommended image dimensions, aspect ratio, upload limits, cropping and safe zones for a social, video, marketplace or print placement (e.g. 'Instagram story', 'YouTube thumbnail', 'Etsy listing', 'LinkedIn banner'). Returns official-source quotes with check dates where available.

tools.name: recommend_image_format
tools.description: Recommends JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, SVG or GIF for a given image and destination, with the trade-offs and measured size change from Pixohub's conversion tests.

tools.name: find_upload_size_limit
tools.description: Looks up official file-size and dimension limits for photo/document uploads: email attachments, government exam and visa forms, avatars, marketplaces (e.g. 'Gmail attachment', 'SSC photo', 'Discord avatar', 'US visa photo'). Returns the quoted rule, its source and a compress-to-size tool.

tools.name: compression_advice
tools.description: Given a target file size (KB) and optionally the image's current size and pixel dimensions, says what to expect when compressing to that size — quality, how much resolution is usually kept — based on Pixohub's measured tests on 44 photos, and links the matching compress-to-size tool.

tools.name: conversion_test_result
tools.description: Returns Pixohub's measured result for converting between two image formats (e.g. png → webp, heic → jpg): output size change, fidelity (SSIM/PSNR), and whether transparency and EXIF survived.
